overview.title: Palm Gorge and Natural Pools
overview.p1: Paradise Valley is the inland escape: a palm-filled gorge, rock pools and cooler water when the coast is hot. It is popular, so the “paradise” label comes with shared selfie spots — go early to keep some of the magic.
overview.p2: Roads can be rough; a driver who knows the valley is worth more than the cheapest taxi. Wear shoes you can get wet and bring water even if you plan to swim.
overview.p3: A morning trip leaves the afternoon free for the beach. Full-day tours often combine other stops — check what is included before you book.

q1.question: Do I need a guide?
q1.answer: Not mandatory, but a local driver helps with the road and timing.

q2.question: Can I swim?
q2.answer: Yes in designated pools when conditions allow — never dive into unknown depth.

q3.question: How long from Agadir?
q3.answer: Often 1–1.5 hours each way depending on the exact stop and traffic.

q4.question: Do I need a guide at Paradise Valley?
q4.answer: Optional for a simple visit; useful for context and timing.

q5.question: Is Paradise Valley suitable for families?
q5.answer: Yes in most cases with normal supervision.
